# Appendix A: Parts and Tools Checklist

## Required Tools Checklist

Essential tools for completing an oil change:

### Wrenches and Sockets

- ☐ Socket set (3/8" drive recommended)
- ☐ Ratchet handle
- ☐ Socket for drain plug (typically 17mm)
- ☐ Torque wrench (helpful for accurate drain plug installation)

### Specialized Tools

- ☐ Oil filter wrench or strap wrench
- ☐ Funnel (at least 3" diameter opening)
- ☐ Oil drain pan (5+ quart capacity)
- ☐ Jack and jack stands (if lifting vehicle)
- ☐ Wheel chocks or ramps (for safety)

### Cleanup and Safety

- ☐ Shop towels or cotton rags (absorbent)
- ☐ Safety glasses
- ☐ Latex or nitrile gloves
- ☐ Absorbent material for spill cleanup
- ☐ Flashlight or headlamp

---

## Required Parts Checklist

### Oil and Filter

- ☐ **Oil Filter:** Honda P/N 15400-PLM-A01 or equivalent
  - OEM Honda preferred for quality assurance
  - Alternative: Fram, Mobil 1, or Castrol equivalents
  - Check compatibility with your vehicle year

- ☐ **Motor Oil:** 4 quarts (3.7 liters) of Honda HG specification
  - **Recommended Grades:**
    - 0W-20 (preferred for cold climates)
    - 5W-20 (all-season)
  - **Acceptable Brands:** Honda, Mobil 1, Castrol, Shell Rotella, Valvoline

### Optional Parts for Complete Service

- ☐ Air filter replacement (Honda P/N 17220-RZA-Y00)
- ☐ Cabin air filter (Honda P/N 80291-SDA-A01)
- ☐ Drain plug gasket (if needed)

## Storage and Organization Tips

- Keep all tools in one designated container
- Label drain pan clearly to distinguish used oil
- Store oil in a cool, dry location
- Keep receipts with parts purchase
- Maintain inventory list for future reference

---

## Pre-Purchase Inspection Checklist

Before purchasing parts, verify:

- ☐ Correct model year: 2005 Honda CRV
- ☐ Oil filter number matches specification
- ☐ Motor oil grade is 0W-20 or 5W-20
- ☐ Motor oil is approved for Honda HG standard
- ☐ All parts are in original packaging
- ☐ Price is competitive with local dealers
